title: Thinkspace Projects — complete demo walkthrough
scope: Full Projects workflow: access, bulk import UI, create draft, statutory approvals, action items, detail tabs (overview, milestones, gantt, comments, actions), edit, submit paths (Compliance, Finance, Under Review), Tasks link, delete, validation preview (sections A–G).
prerequisites: Optional: E2E_DEMO_PAUSE_MS (default 1200) for headed video pacing

crudSummary.Create: Create modal → project details, statutory, action items → Save Draft / Submit Request
crudSummary.Read: Recent list, workflow tracker, detail modal tabs, Tasks deep link
crudSummary.Update: Edit draft, milestone, post comment, action item edit in form
crudSummary.Delete: List Delete with confirm; action item remove in form optional
